sourceRefs.locator: II.37: tenth milestone outside Poitiers, men from the Auvergne and senatorial families among the dead; treasure taken from Toulouse after the winter at Bordeaux.
pp. 43–47, 56–61: date of the battle, Alaric’s death, Gregory’s tenth milestone and rival identifications at Vouillé and Voulon.

summary.de: Der Frankenkönig besiegte Alarich II. im Jahr 507. Gregor von Tours berichtet auch von seinem Zugriff auf den Schatz in Toulouse.
summary.en: The Frankish king defeated Alaric II in 507. Gregory of Tours also records his seizure of treasure at Toulouse.
